anti_overlap: fd-epistemic-regime-derivation covers the regime blend derivation that produces visibility_coeff
fd-hypernormal-gap-dynamics covers performed_trust/actual_trust as a separate channel
fd-downstream-signal-contract covers how D6.3 and D2 consume satisfaction_by_quintile
decision_lens: A satisfaction_by_quintile array that can go negative or exceed 1.0 before clamp is P1. A visibility formula that makes rich countries poorer in satisfaction than poor countries is also P1.
focus: Correctness of the two-layer satisfaction derivation: material base from economic signals, then Meyrowitz visibility modulation per quintile
name: fd-satisfaction-quintile-model
persona: An applied economist who builds computational welfare models. Looks for index-ordering bugs, sign errors in inequality_pain arrays, and visibility amplification that produces paradoxical results.
review_areas: Array indexing convention: spec defines Q1=bottom quintile at index 0, Q5=top at index 4 — verify inequality_pain signs depend on this
perceived_gap computation: must be (material_satisfaction[4] - material_satisfaction[q]) * visibility_coeff — positive for lower quintiles
satisfaction_spread derived signal: must be satisfaction[4] - satisfaction[0] and used in SocialUnrest pressure
Clamp position: composite satisfaction must be clamped per quintile after full formula
growth_share coefficients: must be [0.10, 0.15, 0.20, 0.25, 0.30] not uniform 0.2
economic_growth input source: verify the implementation reads a live economy signal rather than a constant

severity_examples.condition: Occurs if the loop variable iterates q from 0 to 4 and applies inequality_pain[4-q]
severity_examples.scenario: The inequality_pain array is applied with Q5 at index 0, so the bottom quintile benefits from inequality and the top quintile suffers

severity_examples.condition: Occurs if the implementer treats satisfaction_spread as purely derived and omits it from the signal struct
severity_examples.scenario: satisfaction_spread is never written to signals, so collect_pressure_deltas cannot check the SocialUnrest threshold

success_hints: For a high-Gini, low-internet periphery country: Q1 satisfaction < Q5 satisfaction with small spread due to low visibility_coeff
After internet penetration rises with unchanged material conditions, Q1 satisfaction drops (Meyrowitz paradox)
All five satisfaction values remain in [0.0, 1.0] under any combination of valid inputs
task_context: The implementation adds satisfaction_by_quintile as a new HashMap<String, [f32; 5]> channel to PublicOpinionSignals, computed from economic signals modulated by the Meyrowitz visibility coefficient.
